info.title: claudomat
info.description: Claude Code CLI global tool: boards and PR automation for Azure DevOps, batch/run prompts, budget and rate-limit handling, agent roles, MCP feed sync, and built-in azdo/complexity MCP servers

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run multiple tasks from a JSON file with shared budget tracking

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --budget
options.description: 0          Maximum total budget in USD across all tasks (0 = no limit)

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: 10         Default maximum retry attempts on rate limit (per task)

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Default working directory for tasks that don't specify one

options.name: --allowed-tools
options.description: Default allowed (or disallowed) tools for tasks that don't specify them. Can be specified multiple times

options.name: --exclude-branch
options.description: Skip batch when default working-dir branch matches a glob; default includes renovate/* (repeatable)

options.name: --source-branch
options.description: Override branch for exclude check when using default working-dir

options.name: --no-default-branch-excludes
options.description: Do not add renovate/*; only --exclude-branch patterns apply

options.name: --permission
options.description: Default permission: omit for auto; 'unsafe' for --dangerously-skip-permissions

options.name: --timeout
options.description: 30         Default task timeout in minutes (0 = no timeout, default 30)

options.name: --azdo-pat
options.description: Azure DevOps PAT (overrides AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT environment variable)

options.name: --claude-api-key
options.description: Anthropic API key (sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude API authentication)

options.name: --claude-code-oauth-token
options.description: Claude Code OAuth token (sets CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN)

options.name: --output-json
options.description: Write a JSON session report to this file path

options.name: --ongoing
options.description: Keep running in a heartbeat loop after completion

options.name: --ongoing-wait
options.description: 5          Minutes to wait between heartbeat runs (default 5)

options.name: --no-dashboard
options.description: Disable the live dashboard and show raw output instead (always off when --structured-logging is set)

options.name: --stream-verbose
options.description: Include stream-json event type lines (event: user, event: assistant, …) in live output

options.name: --mcp-feed
options.description: NuGet v3 feed index URL for MCP server packages (tag: mcp-server)

options.name: --mcp-feed-pat
options.description: PAT for --mcp-feed (optional if SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN or AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT is set)

options.name: --no-repo-mcp
options.description: Do not merge MCP servers from repo-root .mcp.json

options.name: --structured-logging
options.description: Emit NDJSON log rows to stdout; disables the live dashboard automatically

arguments.name: TASKS_FILE
arguments.description: Path to the batch tasks JSON file

commands.name: boards
commands.description: Find Agentic-tagged epics in an Azure DevOps project, clone repos as needed, and run Claude on approved work items

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --budget
options.description: 0          Maximum budget in USD for all work items combined (0 = no limit)

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Working directory (target repo root)

options.name: --model
options.description: Claude model to use

options.name: --max-turns
options.description: Maximum agentic turns per work item

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: 10         Maximum retry attempts per work item on rate limit

options.name: --allowed-tools
options.description: Allowed tools (repeatable)

options.name: --exclude-branch
options.description: Skip when working-dir branch matches a glob; default includes renovate/* (repeatable)

options.name: --source-branch
options.description: Override branch for exclude check

options.name: --no-default-branch-excludes
options.description: Do not add renovate/*; only --exclude-branch patterns apply

options.name: --permission
options.description: Claude permission: omit for auto; 'unsafe' for --dangerously-skip-permissions

options.name: --timeout
options.description: 30         Task timeout in minutes (0 = no timeout, default 30). Overridden by 'LongRunning' tag on work items

options.name: --azdo-pat
options.description: Azure DevOps PAT (overrides AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT environment variable)

options.name: --claude-api-key
options.description: Anthropic API key (sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude API authentication)

options.name: --claude-code-oauth-token
options.description: Claude Code OAuth token (sets CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN)

options.name: --ongoing
options.description: Keep running in a heartbeat loop after completion

options.name: --ongoing-wait
options.description: 5          Minutes to wait between heartbeat runs (default 5)

options.name: --no-dashboard
options.description: Disable the live dashboard and use classic output (always off when --structured-logging is set)

options.name: --stream-verbose
options.description: Include stream-json event type lines (event: user, event: assistant, …) in live output

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Log every scanned backlog item (including Resolved/In Progress); default only logs actionable items

options.name: --mcp-feed
options.description: NuGet v3 feed index URL; syncs packages tagged 'mcp-server' with claudomat.mcp.json into MCP config

options.name: --mcp-feed-pat
options.description: PAT for --mcp-feed (optional if SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN or AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT is set)

options.name: --no-repo-mcp
options.description: Do not merge MCP servers from repo-root .mcp.json

options.name: --role
options.description: Role (e.g. project-manager): tagged Tasks or tagged backlog; without --role, role-tagged backlog items are skipped

options.name: --include-roles
options.description: With boards and no --role: include backlog items tagged with a pipeline role (default excludes them)

options.name: --process
options.description: Role-chain process id (e.g. software-development); drives tag handoff after successful --role runs

options.name: --remote-org
options.description: Upstream Azure DevOps organization (requires --remote-project and --remote-pat)

options.name: --remote-project
options.description: Upstream team project name (requires --remote-org and --remote-pat)

options.name: --remote-pat
options.description: PAT for the remote org (requires --remote-org and --remote-project)

options.name: --remote-repo-prefix
options.description: Prefix for the fork repo name in the boards project (optional; default empty)

options.name: --remote-work-item-id-field
options.description: Local work item field ref (e.g. Custom.RemoteId) holding remote WI id; requires remote mirror options

options.name: --structured-logging
options.description: Emit NDJSON log rows to stdout; disables the live dashboard automatically

arguments.name: PROJECT_URL
arguments.description: Azure DevOps project URL (e.g. https://dev.azure.com/org/project). Finds all Epics tagged 'Agentic'

commands.name: pr
commands.description: Run one Claude Code session scoped to a pull request (claude --from-pr). Clones/syncs the PR source from Azure DevOps when a PAT is set (not from pipeline branch variables)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --budget
options.description: 0          Maximum budget in USD (0 = no limit)

options.name: --max-turns
options.description: Maximum number of agentic turns

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: 10         Maximum retry attempts on rate limit

options.name: --model
options.description: Claude model to use (e.g. sonnet, opus)

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Working directory: PR source is cloned/synced here when using a PAT; otherwise an existing checkout

options.name: --repo-url
options.description: Repository git URL when using a numeric PR id (not needed if the first argument is a full PR web URL)

options.name: --allowed-tools
options.description: Allowed (or disallowed) tools, actions, and commands. Can be specified multiple times

options.name: --exclude-branch
options.description: Skip pr when branch matches a glob; default includes renovate/* (repeatable)

options.name: --source-branch
options.description: Override branch for exclude check (default: CI env or git HEAD)

options.name: --no-default-branch-excludes
options.description: Do not add renovate/*; only --exclude-branch patterns apply

options.name: --permission
options.description: Claude permission mode: omit for auto; use 'unsafe' for --dangerously-skip-permissions

options.name: --output-json
options.description: Write a JSON session report to this file path

options.name: --timeout
options.description: 30         Task timeout in minutes (0 = no timeout, default 30)

options.name: --azdo-pat
options.description: Azure DevOps PAT (overrides AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT environment variable)

options.name: --claude-api-key
options.description: Anthropic API key (sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

options.name: --claude-code-oauth-token
options.description: Claude Code OAuth token (sets CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN)

options.name: --stream-verbose
options.description: Include stream-json event type lines in live output

options.name: --mcp-feed
options.description: NuGet v3 feed index URL for MCP server packages (tag: mcp-server)

options.name: --mcp-feed-pat
options.description: PAT for --mcp-feed (optional if SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN or AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT is set)

options.name: --no-repo-mcp
options.description: Do not merge MCP servers from repo-root .mcp.json

options.name: --role
options.description: Predefined role (e.g. pr-reviewer); replaces <prompt> with role instructions

options.name: --include-roles
options.description: With pr and no --role: run even when the PR has a pipeline role label (default skips those PRs)

options.name: --structured-logging
options.description: Emit NDJSON log rows to stdout (execution_start, typed entries, execution_end)

arguments.name: PULL_REQUEST_ID
arguments.description: Pull request id or URL (passed to claude --from-pr)
